established_source_contracts.claim: Child fork recovery replaces each main context kq with kqueue() after temporarily setting it to -1.
Final context unref removes the context from the list and closes its kq before freeing the context.
New context construction stores the kqueue return value in context.kq.
Default polling calls kevent on context.kq, preserves errno, then clears each poll revents before translating returned events.
Guard attaches libc close; calls from agent range proceed, while external calls for Gum-cloaked descriptors replace the argument with -1 and report success.
Monitor attaches fork and replaces vfork with fork.
Fork return invokes parent or child recovery before returning to the caller.
FDListCloaker directory filtering in this file is Linux-only; this does not establish Darwin descriptor protection.
Non-Linux close_fds fallback enumerates FD_DIR and calls close on eligible descriptors, or falls back to closerange.
After child setup, close_fds closes eligible descriptors from 3 before invoking exec.
Child setup runs after fork returns; Frida fork recovery precedes it when the pinned fork monitor executes.
